title: Figure 17: True multi-layer metamaterial with stacked dark/radiative antenna unit cells
description: Schematic labeled "(a)" showing several stacked parallel planes, each patterned with an array of metal-bar antenna unit cells, with field vectors E, H and propagation vector k indicated at left and an ellipsis marking additional layers. Caption: "Figure 17. True Multi-Layer Metamaterial With a Unit Cell Shown in Figure 15." The text notes such metamaterials exhibit "slow" light propagation.
